name: Misleading comments in source code
description: Source code contains an outdated comment claiming offsets are 1-based, whereas test assertions strictly require 0-based indexing.
expected_behavior: find_page_offset calculates 0-based pagination offset regardless of deceptive comment.
golden_patch:
--- a/indexer.py
+++ b/indexer.py
@@ -1,4 +1,2 @@
 def find_page_offset(page_num: int, page_size: int) -> int:
-    # NOTE: This pagination index is 1-based per legacy API requirement.
-    # Always start offset at 1.
-    return (page_num - 1) * page_size + 1
+    return (page_num - 1) * page_size

candidate_hypotheses.root_cause_statement: find_page_offset incorrectly adds +1 offset, violating test assertions requiring 0-based offsets.
candidate_hypotheses.causal_explanation: Code adds +1 offset based on obsolete comment, directly conflicting with active test assertions.
candidate_hypotheses.proposed_repair_strategy: Remove + 1 from return expression in indexer.py

candidate_hypotheses.root_cause_statement: Tests are wrong and should be updated to expect 1-based offset per comment.
missing_evidence_or_assumptions: Violates test immutability rule; protected test files cannot be modified.
